lines.rom: janaka janani pada kamala raja nija mastaka para dhari bandaum matu sarasvati buddhi bala de datari
purna jagata mem vyapta tava mahima amita anamtu ramasagara ke papa ko matu tuhi aba hantu
jaya srisakala buddhi balarasi jaya sarvajna amara avinasi
jaya jaya jaya vinakara dhari karati sada suhamsa savari
rupa caturbhujadhari mata sakala visva andara vikhyata
jaga mem papa buddhi jaba hoti tabahi dharma ki phiki jyoti
tabahi matu ka nija avatara papa hina karati mahi tara
balmiki ji the hatyara tava prasada janai samsara
ramacarita jo race banai adi kavi padavi ko pai
kalidasa jo bhaye vikhyata teri krpa drsti se mata
tulasi sura adi vidvana bhaye aura jo jnani nana
tinha na aura raheu avalamba kevala krpa apaki amba
karahu krpa soi matu bhavani dukhita dina nija dasahi jani
putra karai aparadha bahuta tehi na dharai cita sundara mata
rakhu laja janani aba meri vinaya karaum bhamti bahuteri
maim anatha teri avalamba krpa karau jaya jaya jagadamba
madhu kaitabha jo ati balavana bahuyuddha visnu se thana
samara hajara pamca mem ghora phira bhi mukha unase nahim mora
matu sahaya kinha tehi kala buddhi viparita bhai khalahala
tehi te mrtyu bhai khala keri puravahu matu manoratha meri
camda munda jo the vikhyata chana mahu samhareu tehimata
raktabija se samaratha papi suramuni hrdaya dhara saba kampi
kateu sira jima kadali khamba bara bara binaum jagadamba
jagaprasiddha jo sumbhanisumbha chana mem vadhe tahi tu amba
bharata matu buddhi phereu jai ramacandra banavasa karai
ehividhi ravana vadha tu kinha sura nara muni sabako sukha dinha
ko samaratha tava yasa guna gana nigama anadi anamta bakhana
visnu rudra aja sakahim na mari jinaki ho tuma raksakari
rakta dantika aura sataksi nama apara hai danava bhaksi
durgama kaja dhara para kinha durga nama sakala jaga linha
durga adi harani tu mata krpa karahu jaba jaba sukhadata
nrpa kopita ko marana cahai kanana mem ghere mrga nahai
sagara madhya pota ke bhamje ati tuphana nahim kou samge
bhuta preta badha ya duhkha mem ho daridra athava samkata mem
nama jape mamgala saba hoi samsaya isamem karai na koi
putrahina jo atura bhai sabai chamdi pujem ehi mai
karai patha nita yaha calisa hoya putra sundara guna isa
dhupadika naivedya carhavai samkata rahita avasya ho javai
bhakti matu ki karaim hamesa nikata na avai tahi kalesa
bamdi patha karem sata bara bamdi pasa dura ho sara
ramasagara badhi hetu bhavani kijai krpa dasa nija jani
matu surya kanti tava andhakara mama rupa dubana se raksa karahu parum na maim bhava kupa
bala buddhi vidya dehu mohi sunahu sarasvati matu rama sagara adhama ko asraya tu hi dadatu
